db_instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDBX instance. This module does NOT create instances - only manages read-write splitting configuration for existing ones.

i18n.zh-Hans: （必填）现有PolarDB-X实例的ID。本模块不创建实例，仅管理现有实例的读写分离配置。
i18n.en-US: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB-X instance. This module does NOT create instances—only manages read-write splitting configurations for existing instances.

enable_read_write_splitting.description: Whether to enable read-write splitting configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用读写分离配置。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable read-write splitting configuration.

attend_htap_list.description: List of HTAP instances to attend.

i18n.en-US: List of HTAP instances to attend.

auto_attend_htap.description: Whether to automatically attend HTAP instances.

i18n.en-US: Whether to automatically attend HTAP instances.

delay_execution_strategy.description: Delay execution strategy. Valid values are 0 and 1.

i18n.zh-Hans: 延迟执行策略。有效值为 0 和 1。
i18n.en-US: Delay execution strategy. Valid values are 0 and 1.

enable_consistent_replica_read.description: Whether to enable consistent replica read.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用一致性副本读取。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable consistent replica reads.

master_read_weight.description: The read weight of the master instance. Valid values are 1 to 100.

i18n.zh-Hans: 主实例的读取权重，取值范围为1到100。
i18n.en-US: The read weight of the master instance. Valid values are 1 to 100.
